# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 14 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Supply & Land Sales

- **Two GLS sites at Marina South and Orchard Boulevard could add ~500 homes** - URA released two Government Land Sales sites — Marina Gardens Lane (6,007.4 sqm) and Orchard Boulevard (3,438.0 sqm) — with both plots expected to attract keen developer interest. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/two-new-gls-sites-released-in-marina-south-and-orchard-boulevard/)

## HDB & Public Housing

- **PropNex survey: only 55% of HDB owners still aspire to private housing** - A 2026 PropNex survey of 1,530 HDB owners found that 77% now prioritise accessibility and neighbourhood ties over prestige when making upgrading decisions, with private housing aspirations falling to 55.1%. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/a-new-survey-reveals-what-77-of-hdb-owners-want-most-in-their-next-home-and-its-not-price-or-space/)

- **Four HDB shophouse units in Bras Basah and Lavender listed at $13.4M combined** - A portfolio of four fully tenanted HDB shophouse units with a combined strata area of approximately 6,609 sq ft is on the market via Expression of Interest, closing 9 September 2026. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/4-rare-hdb-shophouse-units-hit-the-market-13-4m-2-city-fringe-locations/)

- **Tiong Bahru's pre-war flats now sit outside the HDB resale system with under 40 years of lease remaining** - A look at how Tiong Bahru became one of Singapore's most sought-after neighbourhoods also highlights the lease decay risk facing buyers of older public housing stock, where some flats now transact at $1.5M. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/swamp-and-graveyard-to-1-5m-flats-how-tiong-bahru-became-one-of-singapores-most-desirable-neighbourhoods/)

## Private Residential & Returns

- **The Gardens at Bishan's two-bedders averaged $345,000 in profits over 21 transactions** - The 21-year-old Bishan condo recorded the strongest two-bedder returns in the area over the past decade, at a 36.33% ROI across 21 resale transactions. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/this-21-year-old-bishan-condos-2-bedders-averaged-345000-profits-despite-location/)
